title: mondobrain is no longer maintained
summary: The maintainer yanked mondobrain releases because the project is no longer maintained and recommends datawhys.

constraints: Preserve data loading, analysis workflows, notebook integration, model behavior, and serialized artifacts relied on by users.

steps.title: Move to datawhys
steps.instructions: Replace the distribution and translate mondobrain imports and workflows to datawhys equivalents.

verification.purpose: Run affected data workflow and project tests when defined.
